name: Yoake Yuuhi
source: Another part time worker. Her job is to carry food and materials into the resort facilities. She talks like a boy, is not the least bit modest and gets confident very easily. To put it bluntly, she is just a stupid kid. Very arrogant and has a lot of pride, she thinks her head is very smart. When she is silent she is very cute, her body is also outstanding, but in the end she is still an idiot. Despite all this she has a lot of respect for [url=/c14223]Nagisa[/url] and looks up to her very much.
